figure.name: Karl Kautsky
figure.role: Marxist theorist who argued over democracy, dictatorship, revolution, and party power.
figure.hook: Kautsky = Marxist theory without Leninist party rule.
whyHere: Kautsky belongs here because he makes the democracy question impossible to skip inside Marxism itself.
He matters because socialism cannot be judged fairly if every democratic Marxist dispute is collapsed into Lenin, Stalin, or party-state rule.
figure.cleanIdea: If a movement claims liberation but throws away democratic accountability, the word socialism starts to split.

hallCard.timelineMeaning: A major Marxist dispute asks whether socialist politics can abandon democracy and still claim liberation.

ideas.title: Orthodox Marxism
ideas.plainDefinition: Orthodox Marxism means a current that tried to preserve Marxist theory while disputing both revisionism and anti-democratic dictatorship.
ideas.context: In the Kautsky path, orthodox Marxism is not automatically Leninism. It includes disputes about democracy and party rule.
ideas.whyMatters: Orthodox Marxism matters because it keeps the map from pretending Marxism had only one political road.

ideas.title: Democracy
ideas.plainDefinition: Democracy means public power remains answerable through participation, rights, elections, dissent, and institutions that can remove rulers.
ideas.context: In the Kautsky path, democracy is the line between socialist emancipation and a ruling party speaking over society.
ideas.whyMatters: Democracy matters because the project is about truth and self-government, not just who claims to act for the people.

ideas.title: Dictatorship Debate
ideas.plainDefinition: The dictatorship debate asks whether revolutionary state power can suspend democracy and still remain a movement for liberation.
ideas.context: In the Kautsky path, this is not an academic side issue. It is the question that separates democratic socialism from party-state command.
ideas.whyMatters: The dictatorship debate matters because it stops the page from flattening socialism into communism or communism into any public program.
